sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 新工程PNG的总图/局部详图给本题几何、连接、支承和荷载位置；图中构件索引关联完整属性表，正文不重述拓扑。所有新附件待制作、盲审与验证。
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 几何：柱线x=0、10、20m，外柱檐高6m，中柱到屋脊z=8m；屋面两坡在中柱顶刚接；边界：三柱脚固定；荷载：两坡按实际长度向下6kN/m；属性：外柱C1、中柱C2、坡梁B1，材料M1。（本栏是编题规格，实际用户输入按图/表分工呈现。）
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 屋脊不是自由顶点，而是第三根柱的连接点。
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 屋脊Uz、中柱轴力与柱底反力；附与数值一致的模型/结果图。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 模型核对：无中柱双坡门架增加屋脊支承柱，改变屋面梁支承体系。；数值/表述核对：屋脊Uz、中柱轴力与柱底反力，位置、方向、单位须一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 斜杆荷载与局部轴需验证；本题新增几何/属性与真值均待独立核验；材料截面代号须在本题附录定值。斜杆全局荷载和局部轴适配待验证。
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 柱线x=0、10、20m，外柱檐高6m，中柱到屋脊z=8m；屋面两坡在中柱顶刚接
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 一阶线弹性；自重OFF并保存配置；按附录实际E/A/I/J，不套默认刚度折减；无默认刚性楼板。全局Z向上，核对XZ到求解器平面的映射及Ry符号。题给线载/点力/力矩按原位映射；如作等效节点加载，须保留原始分布荷载并采用与单元插值一致的等效荷载，核验跨内响应及合力/力矩，不用统一楼面载替代。荷载契约：两坡按实际长度向下6kN/m；未指定组合时仅算题定基本荷载，指定组合逐组执行，不能用软件默认包络替换。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 屋脊与中柱共节点；坡梁到柱的连接不得按无中柱屋架处理；执行后按原题完整输出：屋脊Uz、中柱轴力与柱底反力；附与数值一致的模型/结果图。本轮仅规划，不运行。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 计划保存输入PNG/DXF及图中构件/标签→计算节点/构件ID映射、可复现OpenSees输入模型、引擎版本与设置快照、实际运行日志、原始结果表/观测点索引、可视图所用数据。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 尚未确认本题可通过；接口/求解/读回预检重点：屋脊与中柱共节点；坡梁到柱的连接不得按无中柱屋架处理。特殊单元、轴向、边界及组合均不因OpenSees原生支持而视作已接通。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 独立建立并复核OpenSees参考模型，固定版本/求解设置及观测位置；以独立模型审阅、整体平衡及构件端力/节点结果一致性校核。不把展示层插值或图像读数直接当数值真值。

turns.instruction:
Reconstruct the model from the supplied OpenSees input drawings and property appendix. Use OpenSees for the actual analysis. Resolve missing or contradictory essential data before analysis. Preserve the drawing connectivity, supports, load positions and property groups.

Supported roof ridge E1: Uz
Middle column axial force N at its base; tension positive
Column-base reactions at B0, B1 and B2: global Fx, Fz and My
Provide a model/result figure consistent with the numerical table, including support/load/ID mapping and signed result units.

authoringNotes: Appendix completion: M1 is linear elastic steel, E=206000 MPa, nu=0.30, G=79230.76923076923 MPa, rho=7850 kg/m3. These values were unspecified by the source plan and are explicit case inputs.

Use first-order Euler-Bernoulli frame theory or axial-only truss theory as assigned. Self-weight, P-Delta, rigid floors, rigid offsets and staged construction are OFF. All stated loads act together in basic case D; there are no load combinations.

All frame joints are rigid. The planar model retains ux, uz and ry; uy, rx and rz are inactive. Local axis 1 follows member i to j, axis 2 is global +Y, and axis 3 is axis 1 cross axis 2. Member M2 is a section force and support My is a global reaction.
Appendix completion: B1 is a solid rectangular section, B=300 mm and H=600 mm; its explicit A/Iy/Iz/J values are supplied in the property table. The source specified only the section code.
Appendix completion: C1 is a solid rectangular section, B=500 mm and H=500 mm; its explicit A/Iy/Iz/J values are supplied in the property table. The source specified only the section code.
Appendix completion: C2 is a solid rectangular section, B=350 mm and H=500 mm; its explicit A/Iy/Iz/J values are supplied in the property table. The source specified only the section code.
Output-scope completion: the source does not identify a subset of column bases or reaction components, so report Fx, Fz and My at all three bases.
